activeCondition.inputStepFitness: define t0 from captured Vin transition; require Vin 10-90% rise time <= 0.05 * lower edge of Model-A frozen tau band (44.55 us). If slower, return MEASUREMENT_NOT_ADMITTED for the simple-step t63 classifier unless a new pre-data contract explicitly incorporates observed input dynamics.
activeCondition.name: ACTIVE_DYNAMIC

allowedEvidence: captured steady LOW Vin/Vout scalar summaries
captured steady HIGH Vin/Vout scalar summaries
instrument identity/config needed to judge those scalar readings
baselineCondition.name: STATIC_ONLY
baselineCondition.requiredCommit: STATIC_AMBIGUOUS unless the actually admitted static measurement unexpectedly provides a valid unique discriminator; such an unexpected discriminator is EXPERIMENT_ASSUMPTION_FALSIFIED and the active information-gain claim is not admitted.

contrast.informationGainClaim: Only if STATIC_ONLY commits ambiguity and ACTIVE_DYNAMIC later selects one preregistered model with an admitted waveform does E0-B support the bounded claim that time-resolved active measurement produced decision-relevant discrimination unavailable to the admitted static measurement grammar.

externalInstrumentModel.datasheetAccuracyUsedForConservativeStat: ±10 mV ±0.5% at scale <=0.5 V/div; the physical run must reselect/record actual range and may not inherit this planning calculation blindly

loadingAnalysis.conclusion: AD3 loading shifts tau by <0.5% and both loaded tau values remain inside the already-frozen tolerance bands, while the expected DC distinction is smaller than the conservative single-reading planning accuracy bound.

nonClaims: does not prove every static measurement is insufficient
does not prove more bandwidth/sensors are always better
does not use the datasheet planning accuracy as the physical run measurement-validity receipt
does not establish the physical bridge before arrival/execution
does not widen E0-B to a universal autonomous-laboratory theorem
